summary: Auth 401 Refresh Fix testing complete (Iteration 165). Backend: 13/13 tests passed. Frontend: Login, navigation, and CRUD all working. The defensive fixes for cookie domain and 401 interceptor are working correctly in preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: get_cookie_domain() in auth.py correctly derives domain from request headers (Origin/Referer/Host) first, falls back to FRONTEND_URL env var
VERIFIED: For preview/emergent environments, cookie domain is set to None (browser scopes to exact host) - correct behavior
VERIFIED: /auth/login returns 200 and sets session_token cookie correctly
VERIFIED: /auth/me works with both cookie and Bearer token authentication
VERIFIED: /auth/refresh endpoint returns new access_token and user_id
VERIFIED: /auth/refresh returns 401 without valid auth (correct behavior)
VERIFIED: POST /api/events with valid auth returns 200/201
VERIFIED: /auth/logout clears session and subsequent /auth/me returns 401
VERIFIED: Frontend interceptor in api.js handles 401s gracefully - user NOT redirected to login on spurious 401s
VERIFIED: Frontend interceptor uses refreshInFlight shared promise to prevent concurrent refresh calls
VERIFIED: Frontend interceptor only redirects to /login?expired=1 if refresh also fails
seed_data_creation: Test events created and cleaned up during CRUD tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth 401 refresh fix has been tested and verified working in preview environment. The bug (clicking 'New Event' logs user out) could NOT be reproduced in preview - this aligns with the main agent's note that the bug ONLY occurs in production (ourkora.com). The defensive fixes are in place: (1) Cookie domain is now derived from request headers first, ensuring correct scoping regardless of FRONTEND_URL env var, (2) Frontend interceptor attempts silent refresh before redirecting to login. These fixes should prevent the production bug without breaking preview functionality.

backend_cookie_domain_fix.description: get_cookie_domain() derives domain from request Origin/Referer/Host headers first
backend_cookie_domain_fix.preview_behavior: Returns None for preview/emergent hosts (cookie scoped to exact host)
backend_cookie_domain_fix.production_behavior: Returns .ourkora.com for production (cookie works across subdomains)

backend_auth_endpoints.POST /auth/login: Returns access_token and sets session_token cookie - WORKING
backend_auth_endpoints.GET /auth/me: Returns user data with refreshed token - WORKING

frontend_interceptor_fix.description: Response interceptor attempts silent refresh on 401 before redirecting to login
frontend_interceptor_fix.refresh_logic: Uses refreshInFlight shared promise to prevent concurrent refresh calls
frontend_interceptor_fix.redirect_logic: Only redirects to /login?expired=1 if refresh also fails
